csv_scope_of_work: The Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT) is seeking professional consulting services to develop a comprehensive I-96 Corridor Plan for the Interstate 96 corridor extending from the US-23 interchange in Brighton to the Cascade Road interchange east of Grand Rapids. The scope of work includes conducting a detailed existing conditions assessment, evaluating multimodal transportation systems, analyzing demographic and land use trends, identifying operational, safety, freight, environmental, and technological needs, and developing high-level, data-driven strategies to address short-, medium-, and long-term corridor performance challenges.

title: Consulting Services for I-96 Corridor Plan
short_description: Consulting services for a comprehensive transportation corridor plan along Interstate 96 in Michigan.
project_location: New Hudson, Michigan, USA; Interstate 96 corridor from the US-23 interchange in Brighton to the Cascade Road interchange east of Grand Rapids.
project_scope: Development of a comprehensive corridor plan for Interstate 96 covering the corridor from Brighton to east of Grand Rapids. Scope includes existing conditions assessment, multimodal transportation evaluation, demographic and land use trend analysis, identification of operational, safety, freight, environmental, and technological needs, and preparation of high-level data-driven strategies for short-, medium-, and long-term corridor performance.
services: Professional consulting services for corridor planning, transportation planning, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, inspection services, environmental planning/design, public transit planning, and master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- This is primarily a corridor planning and transportation strategy assignment, not a structural or bridge design project.
- No specific bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure is defined.
- The requested disciplines focus on planning, assessment, and studies rather than structural engineering design.
- Pure planning/master planning projects are generally not a target for sbp under the stated criteria.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice concerns planning services only for a long interstate corridor between Brighton and east of Grand Rapids, with analysis of operations, safety, freight, environment, and multimodal systems; no defined construction measures or quantities are provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. As this is a planning study without defined structural design scope, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible from the available information.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, surveying/GIS/mapping, inspection services, planning/master planning, environmental engineering/planning/design, public transit planning, and transportation planning. No specific minimum reference requirements are stated in the provided text.
